items: The winged animals are redrawn as low-poly models on skeletons: heron, raven, spotted owl, penguin, swallowtail, fruit bat and dragonfly, each with its own baby, young, adult and legend, at the sizes they were
The heron and the raven walk, the owl hops, and all three take off and fly low when they go fast, wings beating; the penguin waddles, quicker in a hurry
The swallowtail, the fruit bat and the dragonfly fly at every pace on their own wings: slow painted ones, skin between long fingers, four of glass

Asleep, the raven tucks its bill into its back, the heron hunches on its feet, the owl sits with its eyes shut, the penguin lies on its front, the butterfly shuts its wings upright and the bat wraps itself in its own

Their legends wear plate armour cut with glowing runes: a lamp-billed heron, a gold-hoarding raven, an owl ringed with lit eyes, an ice-plated emperor penguin, a swallowtail with two great eyes on its wings, a great-eared bat with lit fingers, a giant tattered dragonfly
